Why MaxLinear
Enable Smarter Technology

MaxLinear products are at the heart of technologies around you, driving faster and more intelligent networks. You’ll be a part of an elite group of engineers and professionals who bring innovation into reality.

Partner with Leading Global Organizations

Join MaxLinear to shape the future of networking and communications technology. You’ll work with leading companies such as Dell, Meta, Comcast, Vodafone. And, other innovators such as CommScope, Sumitomo, Sivers, etc.

Contribute to a Sustainable Future

MaxLinear strives to have the lowest powered devices in the world. You’ll find our ICs and SoCs in thousands of energy-star products that help build a sustainable future.

Achieve Your Ambitions

If you consider yourself smart, driven and motivated and want to play a role in developing exciting technologies that connect the world we live in, join MaxLinear. Our engineers gain a breadth of experience in everything from semiconductor design to product deployment.

Whether you’re an engineer or in finance, marketing, operations, sales or other professional careers, you’ll find endless possibilities to create a challenging and rewarding career, no matter your role.

Maximize Your Potential
MaxImpact

Want to make an impact in your work? You’ll bring ideas and innovative thinking to make a real difference for MaxLinear and our customers.

MaxSuccess

Curious? Like to solve complex and challenging problems (the stuff that might intimate others)? Join MaxLinear and thrive.

MaxAccess

Our leaders are smart and driven like you! So, don’t be surprised when they strike up a conversation and really listen to your ideas.

MaxChallenge

Be a winner. We strive every day to outthink, outmaneuver and outpace our competition to win in everything we do.

MaxOpportunity

Join our team if you’re exceptional at what you do and want to let your talents shine. Create the career you deserve.

Life at MaxLinear

Locations in 12 Countries. ONE Team. Our diverse cultures are evident in all that we do.

Our focus is to revolutionize the personal experiences of individuals and the capabilities of businesses through engineering solutions that connect the world.

Our commitment is to improve the quality of life for individuals, maximize profitability for our shareholders and employees, build mutually beneficial relationships with our suppliers, and provide valuable advantages for our customers.

"People are our most valued assets. MaxLinear was built on a philosophy that everyone has something to contribute. All opinions matter. We foster respect, leadership and teamwork."

Kishore Seendipru

Founder & CEO, MaxLinear

Opportunities

Engineering

Be a part of a respected engineering team. Our innovative solutions help shape the future of networking and communications technology. You’ll work on projects that…

  • Drive 4G and 5G infrastructure
  • Enable data center, metro, and long-haul optical interconnects
  • Provide broadband access that brings 10Gbit to the home
  • Allow Wi-Fi connectivity
  • Power the IoT revolution
  • Ensure robust and reliable communication for industrial and enterprise applications

Sales and Marketing

Our global sales and marketing professionals partner with our business units and customers. Our customers are global leaders! Whether you are a technical writer, marketing leader, or sales manager, you will work with significant companies throughout the world.

Quality & Operations

At MaxLinear, we value Excellence and Integrity in all we do. Our quality and operations teams are central to exceeding customer expectations through these values.

Corporate Services

These roles are at the center of our success and keep the company going – HR, Finance, Accounting, Facilities.

Internships & Recruiting

Internships

Throughout the world, MaxLinear offers paid internships. We actively hire for full-time positions from our intern employees. As an intern, you will immediately be a part of a dynamic team to gain hands-on experience in your field. Work with and be mentored by bright, fun professionals. Apply online for our internships.

University Recruiting

We work closely with universities, supporting campus career events and providing career centers with open opportunities at MaxLinear. We offer many exciting career paths for graduates with a Bachelor’s, Master’s or Ph.Ds.

Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion

MaxLinear knows that our future success depends on our ability to attract, motivate, and retain smart, talented, and motivated people. To do so we must maintain a work environment and culture that ensures equity, diversity, and inclusion.

We emphasize our core values of Excellence, People, Integrity, and Compassion (EPIC) in our hiring and human resources practices. The MaxLinear corporate culture focuses on providing employees with opportunities, based solely on individual excellence and initiative.

We operate in countries around the globe and are sensitive to the many cultures and backgrounds constituting our employee base and we celebrate our diversity by fostering inclusion across our multi-national organization. We are committed to advancing gender and racial equality by increasing representation of underrepresented minorities as well as females in leadership and technical positions including engineering and other roles.

Competitive Global Compensation and Benefits

MaxLinear offers competitive benefits tailored to local markets and laws and designed to support employee health, welfare, and retirement.
